problem.title: Maximum Nesting Depth of Two Valid Parentheses Strings

approaches.title: Parity-based depth splitting
approaches.summary: Assign each parenthesis to one of two groups according to alternating nesting parity, ensuring both resulting strings have minimal maximum depth.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Uses separate scans over opening and closing parentheses, assigning alternating occurrences to groups via their positions.
Replaces the separate scans with a single linear depth-tracking scan that assigns each parenthesis using the current depth parity.
